title: MoreCrafts
description: Add crafting recipes that should be in the game, to the game!
body:
Add crafting recipes that should be in the game, to the game!
This datapack focuses on adding Quality of Life (QoL) recipes for non OP items such as chainmail armour, glow lichen, and gilded blackstone.

<details>
<summary>What does this add?</summary>

Adds crafting for:

- Horse armour
- Enchanted golden apples
- Name tags
- String
- Bells
- Dead bushes
- Mushroom blocks
- Cobwebs
- Glow lichen
- Glowstone dust
- Glow ink sacs
- Grass blocks
- Saddles
- Shroomlights
- Totems of undying
- Tridents
- Bottles o enchanting
- Chainmail armour

Makes leather obtainable by smelting rotten flesh.

Makes all types of concrete smeltable back into their powder form.

Makes cobblestone an option when using a stone cutter on stone.

</details>

Feel free to use this mod in modpacks, however do not redistribute it, please just have it downloaded from Modrinth.
